retrievalProfile.description: A high-contrast monochrome portrait featuring a subject with voluminous hair and textured clothing, overlaid with vibrant red gestural script.

recipe.visualDefinition: A black and white studio portrait of a woman with large, textured hair and a chunky knit sweater, positioned off-center with a soft-focus background. A bright red, fluid hand-written script is placed in the upper left corner, creating a sharp color contrast against the desaturated image.
coreVisualRelationships: Soft skin tones against coarse knit texture
Dark voluminous hair framing a lit face
Asymmetrical composition with text balancing the subject
coreInvariants: Vibrant red color for the script text

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Subject is positioned on the right two-thirds of the frame, medium-close shot from the waist up.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The subject's eyes and the bright red script in the top left corner.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Eyes start at the red script, move down the subject's hair to the face, and follow the curve of the shoulder.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Significant negative space on the left side, occupied primarily by the graphic text.

colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High value contrast in the portrait; high saturation contrast in the text.

letterConstructionRules: Variable line weight mimicking a felt-tip marker
Connected lowercase letters with exaggerated ascenders
characterSpecificRedesigns: Dots over 'i' or 'j' rendered as small expressive splashes
Extended horizontal terminals on the final letters
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Standalone expressive script to contrast with photographic realism.

candidateDirections.reason: Captures the casual, energetic feel of the original lettering.
Matches the era-specific aesthetic of pop music branding.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a monochrome, grainy film-style portrait of a woman with very large, messy dark hair wearing a chunky knit sweater, looking over her shoulder against a neutral studio wall.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Overlay a bright red, hand-written marker-style script in the top left corner, ensuring the strokes look fluid and organic.

verificationChecks: Does the hair have significant volume and texture?
Is the script hand-drawn in appearance?

mustRedesign: Specific facial features of the celebrity
postGenerationChecks: Check that the red text is the only color element.
Ensure the sweater texture is visible and tactile.
Verify the script does not look like a standard computer font.
Confirm the composition is weighted to the right.
recipe.reuseFormula: Monochrome Portrait + Voluminous Texture + Vibrant Red Script Overlay
